model: cascade examination model (Craswell, Zoeter, Taylor, Ramsey 2008, 'An Experimental Comparison of Click Position-Bias Models'): CTR = examination × relevance, all relevance EQUAL → clicks are pure position bias. examination ∝ 1/rank^gamma, gamma fit so rank-1 ≈ 32% (Enquiro 2005 'golden triangle' eye-tracking number; the 'clicks reveal relative not absolute relevance' framing is Joachims, Granka et al. 2005, 'Accurately Interpreting Clickthrough Data as Implicit Feedback').
label_on_slide: ILLUSTRATIVE — modelled, not from a proprietary click log.
